capabilities: Generate review decks from notes with FSRS-5 scheduling
Build step-by-step courses with quizzes from a topic or notes
Produce short animated teaching videos from a goal
Create practice quest maps with scored missions
Generate Canvas memory maps of abstract concepts
disambiguation: Not a flashcard-only plugin: it also builds courses, practice quests, teaching videos and Canvas memory maps, and AI generation is optional.
extras: Freemium: core features free, Pro is a one-time US$11.99 purchase through Polar with a 14-day refund policy. AI skills are installed into the vault (.claude/skills/ and equivalents); video skills download from GitHub Releases and run scripts (e.g. ffmpeg) via the user's AI tool, never the plugin. Default video narration uses edge-tts, an unofficial Microsoft Edge Read Aloud voice service that may break. README is bilingual English/Traditional Chinese and includes a full network/privacy disclosure.
intentEvidence: Anki solves when to review. EngramQuest solves how to actually remember
motivation: The author states the point is not to collect more notes but to learn, practice and remember them inside Obsidian, closing the loop that most notes never reopen.
problem: Notes are written once and never revisited, so Obsidian becomes a note graveyard instead of knowledge that is actually learned and retained.

relations.evidence: pair them with the Obsidian_to_Anki community plugin
Anki solves when to review. EngramQuest solves how to actually remember

requires.name: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor or Claude Desktop (for AI generation)
EngramQuest Pro license (US$11.99, via Polar) for Deep Dive, Synapse, time-boxed review, extra teachers and recall films
Gemini or Azure key for alternative video narration

summary: Learning system that turns notes into AI-built courses, teaching videos, memory maps and FSRS flashcards, using an AI coding tool you already have.
